description: Add an emoji reaction to a message (or remove yours with remove: true). Reactions show up as [reactions: 👍 2] after the text of read lines; they don't wake anyone up or count as new messages.

as.description: Identity slug to act as (default: the active identity)

remove.description: Remove your reaction instead of adding it

room.description: roomId or index from huddo_list, for this call only (default: the default room)

name: huddo_react
